detached_structure.evidence: A small tan roofed structure sits just southeast of the main house. It could be a deck, an awning or a shed. A small dark structure also sits farther east in the shaded area.
detached_structure.detail: possible small shed or covered deck

signals.notes: The central house has a multi-gabled gray roof with a light patched section on the southern wing. Mature trees shade the east and south sides of the lot, and a dark vehicle is parked in a short driveway at the front near the road.
